sql: SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, c_acctbal, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment FROM customer, orders, lineitem, nation WHERE c_custkey = o_custkey AND l_orderkey = o_orderkey AND o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_returnflag = 'R' AND c_nationkey = n_nationkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, c_phone, n_name, c_address, c_comment ORDER BY revenue DESC
